title: A library of Nyborgs
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: A design and wireframe for keeping as many Nyborgs as you like in your browser, each with its own look and a build for each game. One Customizer covers every game, with a tab per game built from the engine's own tables. Every Nyborg gets the same 9-point budget, the same check runs everywhere, and looks never touch a match.
next: Nye's call on the open questions, then the engine catalog and the save format.
